newsitem.title: USA: WICOR acquires pump manufacturer in Italy.
newsitem.headline: WICOR acquires pump manufacturer in Italy.

text.p: WICOR Inc said Thursday it acquired Majmar Pompe s.r.l., a pump manufacturer located in Milan, Italy, with 1996 sales of about $7 million.

Majmar makes pumps for water circulation and pressure boosting that are used in residential and commercial heating systems, and to boost water pressure for fire protection systems, high rise buildings and municipal water supply.
The value of the transaction was not disclosed. WICOR purchased certain assets and assumed part of Majmar's debt.

"In keeping with our effort to develop synergies among our companies, we expect to blend Majmar into our existing Nocchi Pompe operations in Italy," WICOR president George Wardeberg told shareholders at the company's annual meeting here.
Earlier today, the company reported 1997 first quarter earnings fell to $27.9 million or $1.52 a share from a record $30.9 million or $1.69 a year ago.
"Weather, pure and simple, made the difference," he said. "Last year's unusually cold weather drove earnings to an all-time high. This year's weather was less extreme."
WICOR is the parent company of Wisconsin Gas Co, WICOR Energy, FieldTech, Sta-Rite Industries, Hypro Corp and SHURflo Pump Manufacturing Co.
